# Privacy, security and ethics

* **Local detection.** Face detection, landmarking, quality analysis and the live preview run in the browser (MediaPipe WASM served from this origin). No third-party request is made during analysis.
* **What the server receives.** Landmark coordinates, blendshape coefficients, the head-pose matrix and summary quality numbers. The photo itself is only sent when "Store photos in history" is enabled.
* **Encryption at rest.** Stored photos are AES-256-GCM encrypted on disk; the key is `PSL_ARENA_IMAGE_KEY` or an auto-generated `image.key` (mode 0600). Photos are served only through `/api/images/:id` with no-sniff and a restrictive CSP.
* **Consent gate.** Before a battle can start, the user confirms the right to use the photos, the depicted persons' agreement and that both persons are adults.
* **Deletion & export.** Profiles, analyses, battles and photos can be deleted individually; Settings offers export (JSON) and "delete all data".
* **Input validation.** All API bodies are validated with zod (478-point mesh, numeric ranges, image size limit); unusable images are rejected server-side (HTTP 422).
* **Headers.** `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy` (camera/microphone/geolocation off).
* **No sensitive inference.** The engine only computes geometric proportions. It does not and cannot infer ethnicity, religion, health, sexual orientation or any protected attribute, and the UI avoids degrading language (neutral score descriptors only).
* **Scope.** Reference ranges are community conventions, not validated beauty standards; results are a voluntary geometric comparison for consenting adults.
* **Accounts.** Local e-mail/password accounts; passwords are scrypt-hashed with per-user salts and never logged. Sessions are random 256-bit tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes, delivered in HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookies (Secure over HTTPS), valid for 30 days. Login is rate-limited per client and e-mail. Mutating API calls must originate from the same site. Every query is scoped to the signed-in account; photos are served only to their owner. Changing the password signs out other devices; deleting the account removes all of its data and photo files.
* **Password reset.** No e-mails are sent. Each account holds 8 one-time recovery codes (50 bits of entropy each), stored only as SHA-256 hashes bound to the account id, shown once at creation. A reset needs e-mail + unused code, consumes the code, signs all sessions out and is rate-limited like login. Regenerating codes requires the password. Operators with database access can set a password via `npm run reset-password`.
* **Two-factor authentication.** Optional TOTP (RFC 6238, SHA-1, 30 s, 6 digits). The secret is generated server-side (160 bit), stored AES-256-GCM encrypted with the installation key, shown once as QR/manual key and activated only after a correct code. Sign-in with 2FA issues a 10-minute challenge cookie scoped to the login endpoint instead of a session; 5 wrong codes void the challenge, failures are rate-limited, and each 30-second step is accepted once (replay protection). Recovery codes can replace the authenticator; disabling requires password + code.
* **Open points.** No e-mail verification; sign-up can be locked with `PSL_ARENA_ALLOW_SIGNUP=false`. Use HTTPS when the server is reachable from other machines.


## Manual corrections and the ideal example (engine 2.0)

- **Manual landmark / axis corrections** are part of the analysis input: the moved points (pixel coordinates) and the axis tilt are stored with the analysis, flagged in the result (`corrections`) and shown wherever the analysis appears. Nothing else is collected.
- **Ideal example**: the reference face is rendered from stored model geometry and re-detected entirely in the browser; no image is uploaded, generated by a third party or stored. It is not based on any real person.
- **Fairness.** The engine does not estimate age, sex, ethnicity or any other personal attribute, and the rater still requires the adult-and-consent confirmation. Reference ranges that depend on population (nose and lip widths) are labelled as such; one that additionally failed the construction check (ICD/N) is no longer scored.

## PSL modules (rater, scales, tournaments)

- **Face only, geometry only.** The rubric scores geometric criteria from landmarks; "visual" criteria exist in the rubric but are never guessed — without a configured visual provider they are reported as not assessable. No identification, face matching, or inference of ethnicity, religion, health, personality, age or any other sensitive attribute takes place; "sexual dimorphism" was deliberately not adopted as a criterion.
- **Age:** the app never estimates age from a face. Every rating and tournament requires the explicit confirmation that the depicted persons are adults and that the rights/consent exist; persons declared as minors must not be analysed.
- **Reference images** of custom scales are stored in the same encrypted store as analysis photos, scoped to the owner, deleted with the scale (unless still referenced by a duplicate), and excluded from scale exports.
- **Snapshots:** ratings and tournaments store the scale configuration they used; editing a scale later never changes them. Tournament participants keep a rating snapshot so a deleted profile does not corrupt a finished tournament.
- **Sharing:** there is no public sharing of ratings, images or tournaments. Exports (JSON, print/PDF) are downloads for the signed-in owner only.
- **Deletion:** ratings, scales (with images), tournaments (with participants and versions) can be deleted individually; "delete all data" and account deletion remove them with everything else.
- **Legal note:** processing facial images of other people requires a lawful basis and, in the EU, the data-subject information obligations of the GDPR; biometric categorisation for sensitive attributes is prohibited under the EU AI Act and is not performed here. This documentation is not a legal compliance guarantee; operators should obtain their own legal review before offering the service to others.

## Browser edition (GitHub Pages)

- **No server, no accounts.** The static build (`docs/BROWSER_EDITION.md`) runs analyses, ratings, tournaments and storage entirely in the visitor's browser. Nothing is uploaded; the host only serves files and sees ordinary page-load metadata.
- **Storage.** The SQLite database (sql.js) is kept in the browser's IndexedDB for this site and device. Photos are stored only on opt-in, as BLOBs in that database, without a separate encryption key (one stored in the same browser profile would add no real protection). Clearing site data deletes everything; Safari evicts storage of websites unused for seven days unless the app is on the Home Screen.
- **Backups** are single SQLite files with all data including kept photos; they are created and restored only by the user. Restoring accepts only browser-edition backups.
- **Same safeguards.** Consent and adult confirmations, no age estimation, no identification and no sensitive-attribute inference apply unchanged; all request validation runs through the same zod schemas.
